verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI assistant, since buyers often compare hosted assistants with self-hostable or open-weight alternatives, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Gemini can be self-hosted. Every documented feature (connected apps, Gems, notebooks, the Mac app, Live) runs as a Google-hosted service tied to a Google account, and the Mac app is only a desktop client for that service.
